Find the bug in this Python HTTP server and provide the corrected version. Then save the corrected file.

import json
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler

BOOKS = [
    {"id": 1, "title": "Dune", "author": "Frank Herbert"},
    {"id": 2, "title": "1984", "author": "George Orwell"},
]

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/api/books":
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            body = json.dumps(BOOKS).encode()
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()

HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 8000), Handler).serve_forever()

fixed version to server.py (same endpoints, same functionality, bugs fixed).
Use only the Python standard library.
Verify before finishing: run the server, curl /api/books, confirm valid JSON with correct status,
then stop the server.
